# Expression Matrix PCA

Define the observation unit, fitted matrix, preprocessing, and requested PCA
quantity before accepting a result.

**Required pre-fit gate:** When primary labels repeat and companion metadata is
available, inspect every metadata row in every repeated-ID group for an
explicit secondary identity and conflicts in plausible invariant attributes
before deciding the fitted observations or computing PCA. Matching counts or
multiplicities cannot substitute for this inspection. A numeric sample-level
result produced without completing this gate is invalid.

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
expr <- read.csv('inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv', check.names=FALSE)
meta <- read.csv('inputs/ROSMAP_meta_ad.csv', check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
ids <- names(expr)[-1]
dup_ids <- names(which(table(ids) > 1))
# Repeated IDs disagree on stable attributes and have no secondary key; exclude entire collided groups.
keep <- "'!(ids %in% dup_ids)
mat_genes_by_samples <- as.matrix(expr[, c(FALSE, keep), drop=FALSE])
storage.mode(mat_genes_by_samples) <- '"'double'
rownames(mat_genes_by_samples) <- expr[[1]]
X <- t(log10(mat_genes_by_samples + 1))
cat('original columns:', length(ids), '\\n')
cat('duplicate id groups:', length(dup_ids), '\\n')
cat('fitted samples:', nrow(X), '\\n')
cat('genes:', ncol(X), '\\n')
cat('NA count:', sum(is.na(X)), '\\n')
vars <- apply(X, 2, var)
cat('zero variance genes:', sum(vars == 0), '\\n')
pca <- prcomp(X, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE, rank.=100)
pc1_percent <- (pca"'$sdev[1]''^2 / sum(vars)) * 100
cat(sprintf('"'pc1_percent=%.15f\\n', pc1_percent))
# Compare with full prcomp denominator from full sdev as a sanity check.
pca_full <- prcomp(X, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE)
pc1_percent_full <- (pca_full"'$sdev[1]''^2 / sum(pca_full$sdev''^2)) * 100
cat(sprintf('"'pc1_percent_full=%.15f\\n', pc1_percent_full))
RS"

expr <- read.csv('inputs/ROSMAP_genexp_ad.csv', check.names=FALSE)
ids <- names(expr)[-1]
M <- as.matrix(expr[, -1, drop=FALSE]); storage.mode(M) <- 'double'; rownames(M) <- expr[[1]]
calc <- function(M, label) {
  X <- t(log10(M + 1))
  vars <- apply(X, 2, var)
  p <- prcomp(X, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE, rank.=100)
  pct <- p"'$sdev[1]''^2 / sum(vars) * 100
  cat(label, nrow(X), sprintf('"'%.15f', pct), '\\n')
}
calc(M, 'all_columns')
dup_ids <- names(which(table(ids) > 1))
calc(M[, "'!(ids %in% dup_ids), drop=FALSE], '"'exclude_duplicate_groups')
# Mean duplicate columns on raw scale by ID before log transform, if treating same IDs as one sample.
unique_ids <- unique(ids)
Mmean_raw <- sapply(unique_ids, function(id) rowMeans(M[, ids == id, drop=FALSE]))
calc(Mmean_raw, 'average_duplicates_raw_then_log')
# Mean duplicate columns after log transform, then PCA.
Xlog <- t(log10(M + 1))
Xmean_log <- t(sapply(unique_ids, function(id) colMeans(Xlog[ids == id, , drop=FALSE])))
vars <- apply(Xmean_log, 2, var)
p <- prcomp(Xmean_log, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE, rank.=100)
cat('average_duplicates_after_log', nrow(Xmean_log), sprintf('%.15f', p"'$sdev[1]''^2 / sum(vars) * 100), '"'\\n')
RS"
